title: ECOM Measurement & Intervention Protocol v0.1
description: Protocol-level schema for append-only ECOM cognitive, intervention, provenance, and experimental records. W3C PROV-aligned with ECOM-specific extensions. Storage immutability, referential integrity, access control, and cryptographic guarantees MUST be enforced by the persistence/governance layers; JSON Schema validates record shape and local semantic constraints only.

humanConfidence.description: Human self-assessed confidence. Distinct from predicted probability and AI inference confidence.

$comment: Protocol invariants beyond local JSON Schema validation: persistence is append-only; referenced record IDs must exist; referenced kinds/types must match relation semantics; AI-derived records never mutate or promote human-authored records; outcome commitments must predate outcome observations; MRT eligibility and causal-analysis rules are enforced by application/database constraints.
